Cartoons in Concert
All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.
Gershwin's Greatest Hits
Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.
Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.
Schumann - Violin Concerto And Symphony No. 1

Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.
Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto And Brahms
Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works.
Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.
Gaming X Symphony: Legends And Quests in Concert

The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, with Nordic singer Eivør as special guest in Legends Never Die and more.
Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, Little Russian.
Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all

Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as The Lord of the Rings, Game of Thrones, The Chronicles of Narnia and Harry Potter. Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.
